data.title: 丛雨 · 檐下多了一只接雨碗
data.description: 阵雨把檐下洇湿了一小块，丛雨蹲到木廊边，把浅陶碗顺着地板推过去。头一颗水滴落在碗沿，她又朝里挪了半寸。靛蓝羽织覆着象牙白衣襟，袴裙的橄榄色褶纹在雨光里显得很深。
data.action: 蹲在廊边，细调浅碗的位置接住漏雨
data.lighting: 雨幕散光照在靛蓝亚麻和湿木板上
data.camera: 侧面全身坐蹲构图，前景留出陶碗
data.promptProse: Murasame squats by the shrine veranda and nudges a shallow bowl over the boards, waiting for the next drip to land in it. Her indigo linen haori rests over an ivory cotton kimono and olive pleated hakama, with cream socks in felt slippers. The first drop lights up at the bowl rim.
data.animaCaption: She slides the bowl inward with her fingertips until a raindrop lands in the middle.
